author: 5 On Your Side
title: Man killed in crash on Missouri's Highway 47 near Troy - NewsBreak
text:
22 hours ago TROY, Mo. — A 25-year-old man was killed in a crash on Wednesday morning in Troy, Missouri. According to the Missouri State Highway Patrol, the crash happened shortly before 3:30 a.m. on Highway 47 near Highway H. A crash report said the vehicle, a 2017 Ram 1500, travelled off the right side of the roadway, overcorrected and then travelled off the left side of the roadway. The vehicle then struck a cable box, a ditch, a fence and a utility tractor before catching fire. Read full article
